notice: Written before data/span-holdout-v11 existed and before any model was run on it. The v10 test (data/span-context-v10/test.jsonl) is development from here on: warm was singled out for this check after its v10 test results were seen.
rule: Warm is better than v9 on this hold-out only if its exact-span ML-only F2 is strictly higher and its precision is not lower. Thresholds, checkpoints and data are frozen; nothing is changed after the result.
default_model: Replacing the default additionally needs the predeclared v10 gates (configs/span-context-v10-gates.json). Warm fails 3 of 13, so this hold-out alone cannot make it the default; that requires an explicit decision about the gates.
